notes: Mid-market ecommerce analytics SaaS. Product search + recommendations are core to retention.
Initial interest: replace slow TF-IDF+BM25 pipeline with embeddings-backed semantic search for product discovery and merchandising.
Primary evaluation path: Hosted API to prototype embeddings + search, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and reduced per-token cost.
Quoted: "We need embeddings at scale — weekly bulk reindex of SKUs (500k items), and real-time user query embedding for search/rerank." - Head of Product
Cost-sensitivity: wants clear delta between hosted per-token and Dedicated reserved capacity for sustained throughput.
Prefer model family: open LLaMA-derivative or small instruction-tuned model for text-to-embed to control costs; open to Redwood recommendations for quantized variants.
Security ask: SOC2 + SSO/SAML, ability to route EU traffic to EU region and keep embeddings in their VPC for regulated merchants.
Tech stack: Python service for batch jobs, Postgres + Redis for metadata, currently using Pinecone for POC (evaluating Weaviate/redis as alternative).

Key KPI targets: 95th pctile query latency under 120ms for search path, ingest/batch throughput ~50k embeddings/hr for nightly reindex (target 8-10 hour window), 200 qps sustained for peak storefront traffic with headroom.
They highlighted the need for incremental/bulk embed ingestion tooling, deduping and streaming reindex support; asks about Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/caching.
Demo notes: SE walked through streaming responses, embeddings create + similarity search example, routing to fallback smaller model when Dedicated capacity saturated.
POC results: hosted embed quality OK; latency on hosted API acceptable for dev but cost projection for 200 qps sustained is high — leaning to Dedicated if throughput pricing math works.
Procurement: procurement lead wants T&Cs + data residency addendum; legal requested standard security packet (sent).
